title: AXI4 Write: Independent AW, W, and B Channels
description: Trace a three-beat AXI4 write where this destination chooses to accept and buffer W before AW, both channels absorb backpressure independently, and BVALID follows accepted AW plus accepted final W without depending on BREADY.

annotations.message: This destination chooses to assert WREADY, so the first W beat transfers while AWREADY is LOW and enters pre-address association state. A destination may instead withhold WREADY.
The AW handshake accepts ID 3, address 0x100, and AWLEN=2. WREADY is LOW, so D1 begins a separate W-channel stall.
AW is already complete, but W remains stalled. WVALID and the complete WDATA/WSTRB/WLAST/WUSER payload must stay stable.
WREADY returns HIGH and accepts D1. The AW channel did not need to wait for this W-channel progress.
D2 transfers with WLAST=1, completing the three-beat W burst. Both AXI4 response prerequisites—accepted AW and final W—are now satisfied.
The slave offers BID=3, BRESP=OKAY, and BUSER without waiting for BREADY. The complete response remains valid and stable under backpressure.
The B handshake accepts the write response. Only this edge completes the write transaction from the master's point of view.
